The LSI increases with temperature — water balanced at 70°F may begin scaling at 90°F.
Water with an LSI of -0.1 at 68°F (well-balanced) may have an LSI of +0.4 at 90°F (beginning to scale) with identical pH, hardness, and alkalinity.
Key Facts An LSI of 0.0 is perfect balance; the industry target range is -0.3 to +0.3.
